class.name: SkyScatteringLUT
class.brief_description: Generate a small HDR sky-scattering lookup texture.
class.description: Returns a floating-point LUT indexed by view elevation (X) and solar elevation (Y). RGB stores approximate wavelength-dependent inscattering, alpha stores atmospheric transmittance. Generation happens on demand; callers should cache the ImageTexture and avoid rebuilding per frame. The approximation is meant for stylized skies, not scientific radiative-transfer simulations.

method.name: generate_lut
method.description: Generate a bounded RGBAH image with no mipmaps.
